rationale: The original thesis is intact and arguably improving — price is coiled in a 5-cent band at 97.7% of the daily range, holding above rising VWAP (31.82) and the 9-EMA (31.81) with a fresh high-of-day print at 31.94 as 1-minute volume rebuilds (6K→23K into the highs) after a typical flag dry-up. Adverse excursion of only -0.02% shows no distribution, and the defined risk to the 31.70 invalidation (~$86, ~24% of remaining loss budget) still offers reasonable asymmetry if the coil expands upward. There is no mechanical evidence for a short (strength vs. a weak tape, price above VWAP at HOD) and no reason to abandon a functioning setup 20 minutes in with 5 hours of session remaining.
